description: This file defines a report for procurement tracking in ERPNext, including functions to generate report columns, fetch and process procurement data, and map related records such as material requests, purchase invoices, and receipts.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the procurement tracker report, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles procurement data, integrating multiple related records.

methods.name: get_mapped_mr_details
methods.description: Retrieves and maps material request details, separating records with and without purchase orders.

methods.name: get_mapped_pi_records
methods.description: Fetches purchase invoice amounts linked to purchase orders.

methods.name: get_mapped_pr_records
methods.description: Fetches purchase receipt posting dates linked to purchase order items.

methods.name: get_po_entries
methods.description: Retrieves purchase order and item details based on conditions.
